description: Targeted regression check for the step 4 worktree-path confirmation fix (retro S04)

evals.name: Worktree path gets its own explicit confirmation
evals.prompt: Start a new piece of work for 'feature add-caching' using starting-work. Current branch is main, clean working tree, synced. When asked whether to use a plain branch or a worktree, answer: Worktree.
evals.expected_output: After the worktree-vs-branch AskUserQuestion is answered 'Worktree', a SECOND, distinct AskUserQuestion call fires specifically confirming the computed worktree path (e.g. '.claude/worktrees/add-caching') before any git worktree add command runs. The path is not stated as already-decided inside the worktree-vs-branch question's own option text.
